conclusions: The exact duplicate-postcondition guard correctly rejected goals 2 and 3. No native checks were locally merged or rewritten.
Retry fixed feedback was present once in the actual saved call arguments on attempts 2 and 3; the same exact schema and complete caller were retained.

No client-code or saved-message evidence shows the system role being removed. The Ollama template supports system/user/assistant turns, but metadata alone cannot prove attention or instruction following.

All replies stopped normally after 198 completion tokens; this run has no finish_reason=length evidence. Prompt totals at most 2020 tokens versus configured num_ctx32768 do not independently prove zero server truncation.
Usage cached_tokens refers to reported prompt caching; it is not evidence of a response cache returning prior generated content.
Current repair sends system+user JSON only. Rejected JSON remains nested user context, rather than an assistant turn followed by a new user correction.
The result supports a repair-ineffectiveness/capability limitation in this run, not proof of a serialization defect or guaranteed model incapability.
